title: Pipistrel Taurus Motorized Glider (Official MSFS / Asobo Studio)
company: FlightSim Studio AG (Co-Development with Asobo Studio)
summary: Co-development of the official Pipistrel Taurus self-launching motorized glider for Microsoft Flight Simulator under contract with Asobo Studio, engineering the retractable dorsal propeller mast deployment sequence, engine systems, and soaring instruments.
highlights: Engineered the electro-mechanical retraction and deployment sequencer for the retractable dorsal engine and propeller mast.
Modeled engine start/stop interlocks, propeller positioning brake, and aerodynamic drag penalty during mast extension.
Integrated soaring instruments, electrical bus switching, and engine telemetry gauges for official MSFS default aircraft.
